observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Bosch GSB 570 Professional Impact Drill.
The box appears worn and scuffed at the corners.
The actual drill is not visible; only the packaging is shown.
The box indicates a 570W power rating and a 1.5-13mm chuck capacity.

claims.evidence: Only the box is shown; the tool itself is not visible to verify brand or quality.
While the GSB 570 is capable of drilling metal, the tool is not shown.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, inferior tool.
risks.proof: Photo of the box open showing the drill and accessories.

risks.risk: The tool may be a counterfeit (Bosch is a high-risk brand for fakes).
risks.proof: Clear, close-up photo of the rating plate/sticker on the tool body.

risks.risk: The tool may be non-functional or have internal damage (e.g., worn brushes, damaged gears).
risks.proof: Video of the tool running and switching between drill/impact modes.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual drill outside of the box.
Clear photo of the rating plate on the side of the drill.
Photo of the drill showing the chuck and any included accessories like the chuck key.
Video of the drill plugged in and running.
response.reason: Only the box is shown. It is impossible to verify the existence, condition, or authenticity of the drill without seeing the tool itself.
